semantics.clock: State advances on positive clk edges, sampling x when aresetn is high.
semantics.reset: Active-low asynchronous reset triggered by negedge aresetn; while low, state is empty at every positive clock edge. Reset discards prior input history.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; assert reset before expecting defined behavior.
semantics.output: Combinational Mealy z = (state == ONE_ZERO) AND x. Reflects current x immediately without an additional register; reset to EMPTY makes z zero. At the clock consuming the final 1, state becomes ONE, preserving overlap.

numeric.state_encoding: Three states encoded by 2 unsigned bits
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent two-bit sampled history plus valid-history length; expect z iff last two sampled bits are 10 and current x is 1
tests: Exhaust all 256 eight-bit streams with reset between streams
Check outputs before and after each sampling edge
Change x between clock edges to check Mealy behavior
Assert reset between edges during partial and detected sequences
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite external timeouts and testbench watchdog
